Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 81  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified the FTP link `ftp://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-102/gff3/delphinapterus_leucas/` as the specific GFF3 file needed as of 20/10/2020. While this link leads to the correct directory in the Ensembl release 102 archive, WebSurfer failed to provide the exact direct download link to the GFF3 file (`https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-101/gff3/delphinapterus_leucas/Delphinapterus_leucas.ASM228892v3.101.gff3.gz`) that matches the user's query. The correct link corresponds to release 101 (valid as of 20/10/2020), not release 102, thus missing the temporal constraint. The reasoning for the mistake lies in misidentifying the release archive and defaulting to a later Ensembl release (102 from November 2020), which was incorrectly assumed to have the required file. 

This aligns partially with error Example 9, where the agent's repeated reliance on inefficient or incorrect search strategies and repository misidentification led to the error. While WebSurfer did access appropriate resources, there was no effort to verify the temporal accuracy against 20/10/2020, leading to failure despite progress in accessing archives.
